# dedalus_machine_ssh_session (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "dedalus_machine_ssh_session" "example_machine_ssh_session" {
  machine_id = "dm-ecc2efdd-ddfa-31a9-c6f1-b833d337aa7c"
  public_key = "public_key"
}
```
